description: Java Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the notesbackend application, including root, documentation redirect, health check, and information endpoints.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller defining endpoints for greetings, documentation, health check, and app info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to root ('/') and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI URL.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application information.
